description: This file defines a JsonCodec class implementing serialization and deserialization logic using System.Text.Json. It includes methods for writing and reading JSON data, deep copying, and type support checking within the Orleans serialization framework.

classes.name: JsonCodec
classes.description: A serialization codec that uses System.Text.Json for serializing and deserializing objects within the Orleans serialization framework. Supports deep copying and type filtering based on configuration and runtime type support.

methods.name: JsonCodec
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the codec with type selectors and options.

methods.name: WriteField
methods.description: Serializes an object into the wire format, writing type information and JSON payload.

methods.name: ReadValue
methods.description: Deserializes an object from the wire format, reconstructing the original object.

methods.name: IsSupportedType
methods.description: Checks if a type is supported for serialization/deserialization.

methods.name: DeepCopy
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of the input object using JSON serialization.

methods.name: IsTypeAllowed
methods.description: Determines if a type is allowed for serialization or copying based on support.
